cv: Skills: Python, Django, PostgreSQL. Experience: 3 years backend developer. Project: e-commerce platform with 50k products.

questions.question: In your e-commerce platform with 50k products, how did you avoid N+1 queries in Django?
questions.ideal_answer: Use select_related for ForeignKey and prefetch_related for ManyToMany, and verify with django-debug-toolbar.

questions.question: When would adding a database index hurt performance in your PostgreSQL setup?
questions.ideal_answer: Indexes slow down writes and use storage, so too many or unused indexes hurt insert and update performance.

questions.question: How would you design authentication for the REST API of your platform?
questions.ideal_answer: Use JWT or OAuth2 over HTTPS with short-lived access tokens, refresh tokens, and rate limiting.

cv: Skills: Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn. Experience: fresh graduate. Project: house price prediction using regression.

questions.question: In your house price prediction project, how did you check that your model was not overfitting?
questions.ideal_answer: Compare train and validation scores, use cross-validation, and apply regularization or early stopping.

questions.question: What is the difference between a list and a tuple in Python?
questions.ideal_answer: Lists are mutable, tuples are immutable and can be used as dictionary keys.

questions.question: Which metric would you use for your regression model and why?
questions.ideal_answer: RMSE penalizes large errors, MAE is robust to outliers, and R2 explains variance; choose based on business cost of errors.

cv: Skills: Python, PyTorch, LangChain, FAISS. Experience: 6 years ML engineer. Project: customer support chatbot using RAG serving 100k users.

questions.question: For your RAG chatbot serving 100k users, how did you decide between RAG and fine-tuning?
questions.ideal_answer: RAG gives fresh knowledge and fewer hallucinations without retraining, fine-tuning changes style and behavior; often combine both.

questions.question: How would you scale your retrieval layer if document volume grows 100x?
questions.ideal_answer: Use sharded vector indexes, approximate nearest neighbor search, caching, and metadata filtering.

questions.question: Explain why LoRA is efficient for adapting large models.
questions.ideal_answer: LoRA freezes base weights and trains small low-rank matrices, cutting memory and trainable parameters; QLoRA adds 4-bit quantization.
